note: Enterprise software sales in New York clears the occupation criterion as a successful professional, and he is the clearest good-to-great case in the batch in his own words: 'I'm looking for like a fine-tune, and I think your program is more for somebody who needs a lot more than I do.' Ten to twelve years of consistent training rules out the deconditioned exclusion. Two misses. Income is recorded as a miss on the same basis as Badrane Hriouch — capacity is very likely present but stated willingness was capped at $2,000, and he treated the price as a market question rather than a budget one. Neglected health is a clear miss: he trains three to four mornings a week, intermittent fasts, eats clean, and says his wife tells him he is looking the best he has in a long time. There is nothing neglected to recover, which is precisely the objection he raised about the offer's fit.
